changes: Fixed legacy bug: **Flying Aim Drift**, which affected every class and was especially noticeable when using sniper rifles. Included in the Game Client Patch.
Improved **Game Settings Profiles** with a clearer save-before-switch flow and one clearly marked active profile.
Added detailed **before/after settings comparisons**.
Sped up launch checks so the **Play** button becomes available sooner.
Other small fixes and improvements.
Added optional **Steam Integration** that replaces the Hi-Rez launcher when starting Global Agenda from Steam, enabling **Steam playtime tracking** and the **in-game Steam overlay**.
Added a **Combat Text Scaling Slider** through the Game Client Patch for high-resolution displays.
Added direct **GA CARDS** access for card drops, collections, and trading.
Updated the default interface scale to **130%** and refined the main page and Settings navigation.
Expanded **Client Performance Stability** with additional shader, audio, and network-stat tuning for smoother performance.
Game settings and enabled patches are now applied when you press **Play**, preventing conflicts when game settings are replaced while the launcher is open.
The **Patches** tab now checks every patch's installed status when opened.
**Game Settings Profiles** now start disabled for new users.
Added a built-in **Launcher Changelog** that appears after a fresh install or update. Click the launcher version at any time to reopen it and view older changelogs.
Added direct access to the **Discord support thread** from the changelog.
Added an **On/Off toggle for Game Settings Profiles**, allowing profiles to be paused without deleting them.
Before Play, the launcher now detects changed in-game settings and lets you either **save them to the selected profile** or **use the saved profile**.
Added a new custom **Commonwealth GA launcher icon** for Windows and Linux.
Added an in-game **FOV Slider** in the Video Settings.
DLC files now overwrite mismatched DLC files, with originals restored when removing the DLC.
Added performance command information for `-toggleallsuits` and `-togglebrokensuits`.
Added warnings for launch arguments already handled automatically by the launcher.
[DEV TAB] Added experimental **DXVK** versions: **2.6.2** or **3.0.2**.
Added the **Carbon Capture** PvP map DLC pack.
Added the **Factory 3-4 PvE Maps** DLC: Central Industrial Complex and Recycling Plant 37.
Added **DLC enable/disable** command tips.
Added a copyable in-game chat command reference to the **Info / FAQ** tab.
Added up to 5 switchable game-settings profiles.
Released the optional Game Client Patch, fixing scope in/out stutters.
Added clearer per-patch Apply/Remove controls and enabled indicators. All patches are now optional.
Added Reset All Settings recovery to the Diagnostics tab.
Added a FAQ with useful game and account tips.
Added live player count.
Added Agenda Stats.
Added the Servers tab.
Fixed bugs and reorganized the launcher.
